text:
Maya: Morning all :wave: quick wire — what I shipped yesterday, blockers, and asks for today.

Maya: Shipped PR #4123 (route cache TTL fixes). Canary running in us-west. Need one more review before I promote.
Alex: On it. I'll review PR in the next 30m. Quick note: noticed a 20% p50 bump in canary traces around 03:10 UTC.
Priya: I saw that too. Logs show repeated KV cache misses on model-rt node-7. Investigating whether it's a config drift.
Ben: If it's node-specific I can cordon node-7 and spin a replacement. want me to proceed? :wrench: 
Maya: Please hold for 10min — Priya, can you confirm it's node-level? If so Ben, go ahead after I ack.
Jordan: Heads-up: I'm blocked on the integration test because the ephemeral creds for test infra expired. @infra-bot can you refresh?
infra-bot: Automated: Ephemeral creds refreshed for token id j-9f3a — expiry 02h. Logs: https://intra/creds/refresh/9f3a
Jordan: Nice, thanks.
Alex: For reviews: focus on the cache TTL change and the fallback on stale entries. I left inline comments in the PR.
Priya: Confirmed it's node-level — KV engine on node-7 shows mismatching schema after last deploy. Ben, you can cordon and replace.
Ben: Starting node replacement now. I'll post updates here when it's back.
ops-bot: Deploy plan: draining node-7 -> replace -> run smoke tests. I'll watch and notify on status.
Ben: Replacement done, smoke tests passed. p50 back to baseline.
Alex: Reviewed and approved PR. Maya you can merge when ready; consider a 15m canary window.
Maya: Will merge now and monitor for 30m. Thanks everyone :tada:
Maya: Asks: @security-team can we get a quick sign-off on the TTL change for compliance? I'll open a small RFC after merge.
Priya: I'll draft the RFC and tag sec.
Maya: Final: if anyone needs me, I'm on-call until 3pm PT.
